blocks.html: requirement Some/IP coverage Replaces: PRS_E2E_UC_00239 [PRS_E2E_01444] Upstream: RS_E2E_08540, RS_E2E_08541

blocks.text_en: For profiles 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, and 22 the E2E CRC should be calculated over the following parts of the serialized SOME/IP message. 1. Request ID (Client ID / Session ID) [32 bit] 2. Protocol Version [8 bit] 3. Interface Version [8 bit] 4. Message Type [8 bit] 5. Return Code [8 bit] 6. Payload [variable size]
